# Introduction

This document transforms a dataset that is not in the CWP format into the CWP format:
it first changes the structure of the data, then maps its codes to the CWP code lists.
It is generated from the function `gta_rawdata_wcpfc_nominal_all()` (`R/rawdata_wcpfc_nominal_all.R`), the code that the Global Tuna Atlas workflow runs.

The raw dataset is read from the `data/` folder next to this document, which holds the first
lines of each file under the name given by the tRFMO at export (this name may change).
A summary of the mapping is given at the end; the results are saved in the same folder.

*Knit the document from the repository (here::here() locates its root), or run it chunk by chunk.*

# The function


This function harmonizes WCPFC nominal catch datasets for integration into the Tuna Atlas database, ensuring data compliance with specified format requirements.

@details This function modifies the nominal catch dataset to ensure compliance with the standardized
         format, including renaming, reordering, and recalculating specific fields as necessary.
         Metadata integration is contingent on the intended use within the Tuna Atlas database.

@seealso \code{\link{format_time_db_format}} for converting WCPFC task 2 data structures.
@author Paul Taconet, IRD \email{paul.taconet@ird.fr}
@author Bastien Grasset, IRD \email{bastien.grasset@ird.fr}

@param data_wcpfc The WCPFC nominal catch dataset (file XLS_WCPFC_<date>.csv): a data frame,
  or the path to the CSV file.
@param data_wcpo The WCPO nominal catch dataset (file XLS_WCPO_<date>.csv), idem.
@return The harmonized dataset (data frame), as written by the geoflow action
  (wcpfc/nominal/all/action_wcpfc_nominal_all.R).

```{r}
# Packages the function uses unqualified, attached as in the workflow
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(data.table); library(reshape2); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(readxl) })
pkgload::load_all(here::here(), export_all = TRUE, helpers = FALSE, quiet = TRUE)   # gta package of the repository
gta_rawdata_wcpfc_nominal_all <- function(data_wcpfc, data_wcpo) {
#----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


### Nominal catches
#from wcpfc
wcpfc_species = c("ALV", "BLM", "BSH", "BTH", "BUM", "FAL", "LMA", "MAK", "OCS", "POR", "PTH", "RHN", "SMA", "SPK", "SPL", "SPN", "SPY", "SPZ", "THR")
NC1 <- gta_data(data_wcpfc, reader = function(path) gta_utf8(read.csv(path)))
NC1<-NC1[NC1$SP_CODE %in% wcpfc_species,]
#from wcpo
wcpo_species = c("ALB", "BET", "MLS", "PBF", "SKJ", "SWO", "YFT")
NC2 <- gta_data(data_wcpo, reader = function(path) gta_utf8(read.csv(path)))
NC2<-NC2[NC2$SP_CODE %in% wcpo_species,]

NC2$AreaName <- "WCPO"
NC1$AreaName <- "WCPFC"

#bind both sources
NC <- rbind(NC1,NC2)

colnames(NC)[colnames(NC) == "YY"] <- "Year"
colnames(NC)[colnames(NC) == "FLAG_CODE"] <- "FishingFleet"
colnames(NC)[colnames(NC) == "GEAR_CODE"] <- "Gear"
colnames(NC)[colnames(NC) == "SP_CODE"] <- "Species"
colnames(NC)[colnames(NC) == "SP_MT"] <- "Catch"
NC$Catch<-as.numeric(NC$Catch)
NC <- NC[!is.na(NC$Catch),]
NC <- NC[NC$Catch != 0,]
NC$CatchUnits <- "t"
NC$SP_NAME <- NULL
NC$FLEET_CODE <- NULL

NCAreaCWPgrid<-NA
NC$School<-"UNK"
NC$CatchType<-"NC"
NC$CatchUnits<-"t"
NC$RFMO<-"WCPFC"
NC$Ocean<-"PAC_W"

NC$MonthStart<-1
NC$Period<-12
#Format inputDataset time to have the time format of the DB, which is one column time_start and one time_end
NC<-format_time_db_format(NC)
NC <- NC[NC$Catch !=0 ,] #not sure if needed

NC <-NC[c("FishingFleet","Gear","time_start","time_end","AreaName","School","Species","CatchType","CatchUnits","Catch")]

# remove 0 and NA values 
NC <- NC[!is.na(NC$Catch),]
NC <- NC[NC$Catch != 0,]

NC <- aggregate(NC$Catch,
		FUN = sum,
		by = list(
			FishingFleet = NC$FishingFleet,
			Gear = NC$Gear,
			time_start = NC$time_start,
			time_end = NC$time_end,
			AreaName = NC$AreaName,
			School = NC$School,
			Species = NC$Species,
			CatchType = NC$CatchType,
			CatchUnits = NC$CatchUnits
		)
	)


colnames(NC)<-c("fishing_fleet","gear_type","time_start","time_end","geographic_identifier","fishing_mode","species","measurement_type",
                "measurement_unit","measurement_value")
NC$source_authority<-"WCPFC"
NC$measurement<-"catch"
NC$measurement_processing_level<-"raised"
#----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#@eblondel additional formatting for next time support
NC$time_start <- as.Date(NC$time_start)
NC$time_end <- as.Date(NC$time_end)
  NC
}
```

# Harmonisation

```{r}
path_to_raw_dataset1 <- here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'wcpfc', 'nominal', 'all', 'data', 'XLS_WCPFC_2025-11-27.csv')
path_to_raw_dataset2 <- here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'wcpfc', 'nominal', 'all', 'data', 'XLS_WCPO_2025-11-27.csv')
georef_dataset <- gta_rawdata_wcpfc_nominal_all(path_to_raw_dataset1, path_to_raw_dataset2)
write.csv(georef_dataset, here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'wcpfc', 'nominal', 'all', 'data', 'XLS_WCPFC_2025-11-27_harmonized.csv'), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Mapping to the CWP code lists

```{r}
fact <- "catch"
mapping_codelist <- map_codelists_no_DB(fact, dataset_to_map = georef_dataset, mapping_keep_src_code = FALSE, summary_mapping = TRUE, source_authority_to_map = c("IATTC", "CCSBT", "WCPFC"))
```

Unmapped values, then the results:

```{r}
georef_dataset <- mapping_codelist$dataset_mapped %>% dplyr::mutate(fishing_fleet = ifelse(fishing_fleet == 'UNK', 'NEI', fishing_fleet), gear_type = ifelse(gear_type == 'UNK', '99.9', gear_type))
# The summaries are NULL when nothing was mapped (e.g. tRFMOs not in source_authority_to_map)
if (!is.null(mapping_codelist$recap_mapping)) data.table::fwrite(mapping_codelist$recap_mapping, here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'wcpfc', 'nominal', 'all', 'data', 'XLS_WCPFC_2025-11-27_recap_mapping.csv'))
if (!is.null(mapping_codelist$not_mapped_total)) data.table::fwrite(mapping_codelist$not_mapped_total, here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'wcpfc', 'nominal', 'all', 'data', 'XLS_WCPFC_2025-11-27_not_mapped_total.csv'))
data.table::fwrite(georef_dataset, here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'wcpfc', 'nominal', 'all', 'data', 'XLS_WCPFC_2025-11-27_CWP_dataset.csv'))
head(mapping_codelist$recap_mapping)
```
